points.description: States that the main stack operations are push (add/insert an element onto the top) and pop (remove the top element). Both operations must be named.
points.partial_credit: Half credit (2) if only one of push or pop is named, or both are named with a minor error in what they do.

points.description: Gives the correct meaning of the operations: push adds an item to the top of the stack and pop removes the item from the top (LIFO).
points.partial_credit: Half credit if only one operation is correctly described.

rubric.notes: Full marks for naming both push and pop, in any wording; a brief answer like "push and pop" earns at least 4 of 5. The last mark is for saying what they do (add to top, remove from top). Naming only one operation gets part marks; extra correct operations such as peek/top, isEmpty are fine, but answers naming unrelated operations (e.g. enqueue/dequeue) without push/pop earn 0.
